capabilities.astra: Visual closed-loop reasoning with explicit end-effector motion, grasp, release, waits and recovery. Useful when deliberate geometric reasoning and inspection are needed. Uses the configured language-model provider; actual identity must be recorded.
capabilities.wam: WorldScape 2.0 learned visual world-action controller. Uses three RGB views and raw joint state; emits continuous 24-step absolute joint chunks with temporal memory. Can represent coordinated manipulation; current task success is unverified.
